name: Orthostatic response features (research prototype)
description: Computes blood-pressure and heart-rate responses to standing from a beat-to-beat stand test and checks the consensus orthostatic-hypotension and HR-rise criteria.
intended_use: Research exploration of NASA's primary return-to-gravity cardiovascular risk (orthostatic intolerance).
not_intended_for: Predicting astronaut tolerance of re-entry or landing; diagnosis.

inputs.description: Beat-level SBP/DBP/HR around a sit- or lie-to-stand test (no device feed exists yet).

datasets.name: CVES v1.0.0 sit-to-stand subset
datasets.citation: Novak V. et al. Cerebral Vasoregulation in Elderly with Stroke (PhysioNet)
